name: reel-factory
description: Autonomous Instagram Reel production: trend discovery or your topic -> research -> creation mode (10 modes, or AI Select) -> script -> storyboard -> voice, music, SFX, visuals -> Remotion render -> QA -> 1080x1920 reel. Adapts to the machine it runs on (probe + free fallbacks). Built from a study of 105 AI/tech reels.
